title: DataApiConfig
description: Configuration for the Neon Data API on a branch, providing a PostgREST-compatible HTTP interface to the database.

enabled.description: Whether the Data API is enabled for this branch

database_name.description: The target database for the Data API

exposed_schemas.description: List of database schemas exposed through the Data API

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows returned in a single API response

auth_provider.description: The authentication provider that validates JWT tokens for Data API requests
